subject: negative length vectors are not allowed error

messages.author: 110371b5b103886f
messages.subject: negative length vectors are not allowed error
parts:
I'm trying to run calc_genoprob for single chromosome (chr20), to compute haplotype probabilities for a population descended from 8 founders. I get the following error:

Error in .calc_genoprob2(cross$crosstype, t(cross$geno[[chr]][group[[i]],  :    negative length vectors are not allowed

I used code from this repo: https://github.com/daniel-munro/qtl2-founder-haps/tree/main, to generate the input files for the cross object. When I reran it for chromosome 19, I didn't run into any errors. I also subsetted to only two samples, which also ran without error. I've attached a picture of the chromosome 20 error when I use all 340 samples, as well as the input files for the 2 samples. The only difference is the genotype matrix, all the other input files are the same. What could be causing the negative length vector? 

Sabrina

That's wild. Definitely a new one for me.
It's hard to see what might be going on without access to the data and ability to reproduce the error.

karl
